name: Arms Badge
description: Reflects the Arms the serviceman is from.

name: Exceptional Skills Badges
description: Takes precedence over all Skills Badges.

name: Skills Badges
description: Awarded for a professional skill or specialised training.

name: Proficiency Badges
description: Awarded for basic soldiering or physical proficiency. Not more than two can be worn at any one time.

name: Incentive Badges
wornOn: Flap of the left breast pocket
description: Awarded for good job performance and services rendered.

name: Identification Badge
wornOn: Right side of the uniform, in addition to foreign badges

name: Formation Badges
description: Represents the specific Arms or branch of service a soldier belongs to. The source page does not say where these are worn.
